title: AMR Engineering Portfolio
description: A monorepo portfolio platform built as a genuine engineering exercise, not a template. The backend is a four-layer Clean Architecture .NET 10 Minimal API with enforced layer boundaries, a Repository Pattern over JSON content, and IMemoryCache — sized for a portfolio but structured for extensibility. The frontend is Next.js 15 App Router with ISR, three-locale support (EN/AR/NL), RTL layout, and dark mode. An AI chat integration is planned for Phase 3.
